lines.japanese: ──神々の治世より我らを育んできた国土と、そこに暮らしてきたすべての民のために！
lines.english: —for the land that has nourished us since the reign of the gods, and for every soul who has dwelled upon it!

lines.japanese: 「ロイヒテン・グレタ！　我らに光あれ！」
lines.english: “Light upon Gretagard! May the light be with us!”

lines.japanese: 王族も平民も関係なく、みなが等しく平穏に過ごせる──
lines.english: Noble and commoner alike, all living together in equal peace—

lines.japanese: 侵略者の脅威に怯えることもなく、グレタガルドの民であることに誇りを持って過ごせる──
lines.english: All free from terror of the invader, living with pride as children of Gretagard—

lines.japanese: そんな日々を取りもどしたい。
lines.english: I longed to restore those days.

lines.japanese: 「ただひとつ、皆の幸せのために！」
lines.english: “For one purpose alone: the happiness of all!”

lines.japanese: だが旅は長く、戦いは厳しいものになるだろう。
lines.english: But the journey would be long, and the battle harsh.

lines.japanese: 私は大聖剣グレタカリバーをおさめて馬を降りた。長旅では鋭気を養うことも肝要だ。サドルバッグから水筒を抜きだしてひとくち喉を潤す。
lines.english: I sheathed the holy greatsword Gretacalibur and dismounted. On a long journey, one must husband one’s strength. Drawing a flask from my saddlebag, I took a swallow and wet my throat.

lines.japanese: 胸の昂ぶりを抑えて一心地ついてみれば、ふと……なんだろう、顔や腕の剥きだされた肌にどこか違和感があった。
lines.english: Once I had calmed the exultation in my breast and caught my breath, I noticed something strange: an indefinable sensation upon the bare skin of my face and arms.

lines.japanese: 大気が凝りかたまっている。やけに肌が「まなつく」のだ。おそらくこのあたりは、マナの密度が濃い土壌なのだろう。
lines.english: The very air had congealed. It felt strangely mana-sticky against my skin. The soil of this region must be richly saturated with mana.

lines.japanese: 私はかつての仲間のことを思った。
lines.english: I thought of my former companions.

lines.japanese: 妖術師ガルーダ・ダークブラック。いまここに彼の存在とその比類なき魔法の技があれば、疑いなく大きな戦力となったであろう。
lines.english: Garuda Darkblack, master of sorcery. Were he here now, his presence and matchless command of magic would surely add immeasurably to our strength.

lines.japanese: そして“久遠の翼”イーグル。
いまは千々に砕けた我らなれど、いつかまた結集のときは来る。我ら“万色の四枚羽根”が揃えば、いかなる脅威にさえも立ちむかえるのだ。
lines.english: Though we are scattered now into a thousand fragments, the day shall come when we gather once more. United, we Four Wings of Many Colors can stand against any threat.

lines.japanese: 私は水筒の栓を閉めながら、頭上にただ悠々と広がる白い空を仰いだ。
lines.english: As I stoppered my flask, I looked up at the white sky spreading vast and untroubled overhead.

lines.japanese: 皆もまた、どこか彼方の地で、この泣きだしそうな冬の空を眺めているのだろうか。
lines.english: Were the others, somewhere in the distant reaches of the land, also gazing upon this winter sky that seemed ready to weep?

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
